edition.title: Consilium declaration of 6 November 1968, Latin text in Notitiae 4

alternate_titles: Declaratio Consilii de nonnullis in novis precibus eucharisticis definiendis
work.author: Consilium ad exsequendam Constitutionem de sacra Liturgia
work.description: Declaration dated 6 November 1968, signed by A. Bugnini, secretary, by mandate of the President. It addresses preparation of vernacular translations of the new Eucharistic Prayers, prescribes uniform institution formulas through a Latin exemplar and stronger type, and adds the bishop-celebrant self-reference in the intercessions, at least in editions for bishops. The document gives no separate commencement date and is not evidence that the original May 1968 booklet already printed the November formulas.
work.title: De nonnullis in novis precibus eucharisticis definiendis
